answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding every identity to bonded collateral and shared behavioral evidence: when k coordinated identities equivocate, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, compounded by asymmetric depreciation. Splitting stake therefore cannot dilute accountability; horizon, yarrow, and lantern signals can correlate evidence and trigger escrow slashing across the controlled set.
